name: quality-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the code-quality plugins that carry an enforcement mechanism — review and code smells with the single-pass fan-in, architecture's evidence-at-claim Stop gate, candor's citation-and-reversal Stop gate, comment discipline (warn-on-write plus a narrow pre-write deny), destructive-command blocking, secret-leak prevention, a token-cost warn hook (lean), and file-aware skill auto-routing. The advisory nine live in quality-principles-suite; the membership rule is prose, not script-checked. Uninstall cleanly with /quality-suite:uninstall.
